one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-06 to 2026-11-04. Vicor's Q3-26 report is not yet dated (finviz still shows the July date), but Vicor reports on the third Tuesday after quarter-end (Oct 21 2025, Apr 21 and Jul 21 2026), so ~Oct 20 falls inside the window. Hyperscaler Q3 capex calls (late Oct) also fall inside. The >$186M headline is pre-announced, so what moves the stock is the first split of the >= ~$29M VPD royalty into back-royalty and run-rate, the Q4 guide (Q4 fixed-licence revenue rises to $10M), backlog vs $380M, and product GM vs 46.7%. Supply: the CEO's 10b5-1 plan keeps selling (Form 4: ~20k shares on Oct 1 at $307-330; 8.33M shares still held directly) and a +66% run since Sep 16 adds reversal risk; momentum and possible new licensees offset it. I centre at ~$300 (slightly below spot for reversal and insider supply) with a mixture of 0.8 x 24% and 0.2 x 45% one-month log-sd (fat tail for the royalty disclosure). This is close to round 1.

fair_value.method: Recurring earnings only, interest income excluded (net cash added). P/E (60%): NTM recurring EPS at Oct-2027 $5.62 x 30x + $9 net cash = $177.7. SOTP (40%): product $3.18 x 26x = $82.8 + royalties $2.44 x 32x = $78.1 + $9 cash = $169.9. Blend 0.6 x 177.7 + 0.4 x 169.9 = $174.6 -> $175. Peer median 26.1x after the 2026-10-06 BELFB (adjusted basis) and IFX (FY Sep-2027 EPS) fixes. Excluded: the fixed $60M licence (revenue ends Q3-27; only a 50% renewal credit in 2028), the 2025 $45M settlement, the Q2-26 tax benefit and the back-royalty part of the Q3 VPD royalty.

bear.story: The Q3 VPD royalty proves mostly back-royalty and settles near $8-10M/qtr; the licensee shifts volume to unlicensed suppliers; AI capex digestion and product GM stuck below 48%; the fixed licence ends Q3-27 without renewal. NTM EPS ~$4.6 x ~27x (peer median) + $9 cash = ~$135, below the $184 pre-licence level.

base.story: Recurring royalties ~$35M/qtr (legacy $15M + VPD $20M), product +38% in 2027, GM back to ~50%. NTM recurring EPS ex-interest $5.62 x 33x + $9 cash = $195, plus ~$22 of option value that the market will price by Oct-2027: a 50% chance of a further VPD licence or renewal at ~$20M/qtr ahead of the 337-TA-1484 determination (USITC target date 2027-09-20). It sits ~$42 above fair value: the gap is new-licence option value and a 33x vs 30x multiple, not a different earnings view.

bull.story: More hyperscalers/OEMs license after the second ITC case, VPD royalties scale with accelerator units to $40M+/qtr, Gen-2 VPD wins sockets, Fab-2 on time; 2028-29 NTM EPS ~$9.5 x 43x (MPWR level, top of the power-peer range) + cash = ~$420.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No growth premium: VICR's recurring EPS growth (+34% 2028) is close to the peer median next-year growth (~+31%). A ~15% premium on the blended multiple only reflects the royalty mix (~30% of gross profit at ~100% margin with no capex), which raises returns on capital for as long as the ITC orders and patents last. Product earnings get the median (26x) because product GM (47-52%) is below MPWR's, Fab-1 caps volumes until Fab-2, and one or a few customers make up most Advanced Products revenue. The royalty multiple stays at 32x, not the 35x of round 1, because licences run two years and are renegotiated (Q2 call), and the VPD licensee may buy from unlicensed suppliers. Changes since round 1: CRDO and ALAB were dropped (AI connectivity, not power), which moves the median from 27.1x to 27.1x (unchanged) and the top of the range from 56.7x to 42.3x. Sell-side outperform calls were not used. Citation fix 2026-10-06: BELFB on adjusted consensus (22.98x) and IFX on FY Sep-2027 EPS (22.3x) move the median from 27.1x to 26.1x; multiples cut by 1x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$155 (~16% under the $184 pre-licence level of Sep 16 and ~26x my NTM recurring EPS ex-interest ($5.62), plus $9 cash) the market would be pricing a failed licensing leg: the VPD royalty mostly back-payment (run-rate < $10M/qtr), the late-2027 renewals repricing down, or an adverse 337-TA-1484 outcome; and/or product backlog rolling over below ~$300M with AI capex. That is a fundamental break, not 95%-vol noise.

reasoning: Round 2. Verified on primary sources: the 10-Q (cash $453.6M, no financial debt, total liabilities $59.6M; 46.1M basic shares, 47.7M diluted; $28.56M paid to SynQor on 2026-03-18; usage-based royalty policy), the Q2 call (fixed $60M licence recognised $15M/$5M/then $10M per quarter for four quarters, so revenue ends Q3-27; cash runs $5M then $10M per quarter), and the Sep-30 release (>30% Q3 guide). The supervisor's main points therefore stand and I adopt them: my 'through Q1-28' was the cash schedule; the $28.6M was an outflow, not income; the 'debt $7.6M' was lease liabilities. On its challenge to my 90% recurring share for the Q3 VPD royalty: I agree it was too high. A licence signed two weeks before quarter-end, under a policy that books the licensee's earlier sales at signing, very likely includes back-royalty, so I now treat ~$20M/qtr (65-70%) as run-rate. I partly disagree on renewal: the CEO describes two-year all-inclusive deals as renegotiated at expiry, so I credit 50% of a renewal ($20M) in 2028 rather than zero. Rebuilt recurring EPS: 2027 $4.64, 2028 $6.20, NTM at horizon $5.81 (round 1 $5.92). Multiple cut from 36x to 31x: dropping CRDO/ALAB leaves 10 power peers at a 27.1x CY2027 median (19.4-42.3x), and VICR's growth is not above the peers', so only the royalty mix earns a ~15% premium. Fair value $185 (P/E $189, SOTP $178), down from $217 (corrected to $175 on 2026-10-06, see below). Reconciliation with the ladder: the base scenario ($225) = $5.81 x 33x + $9 + ~$22 option value for a further licence/renewal by the ITC determination. It sits $40 above fair value only for option value the market will price at the horizon; the earnings view is the same. Bear $135 (30%) / base $225 (46%) / bull $420 (24%) as a lognormal mixture (sigmas 0.42/0.30/0.36) give a median ~$223, mean ~$245, P(>= $306) 0.27 and P(>= $611) 0.04. The overall log-sd is ~0.55, below the 95% realised vol, which was inflated by the $383->$182->$306 round trip. Alternative-lane signals (Stocktwits optimism, GuruFocus/QuiverQuant aggregates) no longer move any number, per the supervisor's source review. The insider flow cited is verified on EDGAR Form 4s (CEO and a director sold at $307-330 on Oct 1). No option prices or implied vol were used. Citation fix 2026-10-06: other income ($14M/$10M) was in EPS while $9/share net cash was also added, a double count; EPS is now ex-interest (NTM $5.62). BELFB moved to the adjusted basis (22.98x) and IFX to FY Sep-2027 EPS (22.3x), so the peer median is 26.1x and the multiples are 30x (P/E) and 26x (product). P/E $177.7, SOTP $169.9, fair value $175; base $217; 12-month ladder shifted by 175/185. Lease liabilities are $7.6M, not $5.8M. 95% realised vol re-checked on Twelve Data daily closes (95.2%).
